description: Replaces `Aspire.Azure.AI.OpenAI` and `Aspire.Azure.AI.Inference`, which are discontinued, with two new packages: `Aspire.Azure.AI.Projects` for Foundry project-based `AIProjectClient` registration, and `Aspire.Azure.AI.Extensions.OpenAI` for both Foundry project (`ProjectOpenAIClient`) and Azure OpenAI account registrations backed by the standard OpenAI SDK. Also fixes Foundry hosted/prompt agents failing on Send Message by aligning the Azure SDK on 3.0.0-beta.3, and removes the preview `HostedAgentConfiguration.Tools` property since the new SDK no longer serializes hosted-agent tools.
name: New Azure AI client packages replace Azure.AI.OpenAI and Azure.AI.Inference
